task.name: Factorial decompositions into distinct factors above the index

task.description: Return 1..12 DISTINCT integers all greater than 12, with product exactly 12!. Minimize the LARGEST factor; the number of factors is variable. Exact finite version of equation (6). Distinct from the existing 100! benchmark: no fixed factor count, all factors must exceed 12, and the objective minimizes the largest rather than maximizing the smallest.
